latin: Secundum omnes philosophos dicendum est deum necessario agere quicquid agit.
translation: Every philosopher, it must be said, holds that whatever God does, he does of necessity.
translation_note: Farmer's note (farmer1998:20063) reads the phrase 'according to all philosophers' as signaling an implicit double-truth, resolved elsewhere by Pico's hierarchical modes of necessity (cf. 2>14-15); pico_stance is accordingly given as unstated rather than endorses.
